dedupe_keys.name: atcll aveiro vehicular its g5 and cellular network performance

description: ATCLL Network Performance Data contains outdoor vehicular communications measurements from Aveiro, Portugal. The Instituto de Telecomunicações team publishes separate CSV files for an ITS-G5 network and a commercial LTE/5G network. The ITS-G5 setup has eleven stationary nodes and eight mobile nodes; the cellular measurements use one mobile node. Fields describe node identity, test location, signal strength and network performance. Zenodo archives the GitHub release free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is Aveiro. The repository README explicitly excludes periods without connectivity, which is a material limitation for outage and availability modelling. Exact collection dates were not established from the inspected metadata. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating connected-state throughput and signal-quality relationships in mobility-aware communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network simulator, without verified trace integration. Missing disconnected periods must be modelled separately. No CSV file, code archive or communications experiment was downloaded or run.
